response.overview: A spirited girls' football team from Mumbra travels to Bengaluru to play its first national tournament as it challenges norms and claims public space. Theirs is a quiet, determined act of courage, belonging, and change.  Credits:  Directed by — Garima Sadhwani (@garimasadhwani_)  Produced by — Dimpy Agrawal (@dimpyagrawal), Meena Agrawal, Narayan Krishnaswamy  Supervising Producer — R Prashanth (@prashanthrajagopal)  Cinematography — Juhi Sharma (@juhifilms), Neil Dmello (@neil_dmello)  Editor — Vibhav Nigam (@writeofcentre)  Sound Recordist — Mithra Madhyastha P  Sound Mix — Burhan Kundawala  A Janato film, presented by the Azim Premji Foundation.  Produced by @gubbaraentertainment.
